name: The Riverbank
objective: Reach Clearfell

name: Clearfell Encampment
objective: Speak with Renly and Una

name: Clearfell
objective: Find the path into the Grelwood

optional.hint: Defeat Beira for cold resistance
Defeat the Devourer for Finn

name: The Grelwood
objective: Investigate the Tree of Souls

shortcut.cue: Tag the Grim Tangle waypoint early
shortcut.detail: If you reach the Grim Tangle entrance while exploring the Grelwood, step inside to activate its waypoint. After finishing Una’s turn-in in town, use that waypoint to resume the route.

optional.hint: Defeat the Brambleghast
Investigate the Starlit Rite and runic vault

name: The Red Vale
objective: Recover the girdles from the rust obelisks

shortcut.cue: Portal after collecting all three pieces
shortcut.detail: After defeating the Rust King and collecting all three obelisk quest items, open a portal to town. Get the Runed Spikes from Renly, then use the Grelwood waypoint to return to the Tree of Souls.

name: The Grim Tangle
objective: Cross to the Cemetery of the Eternals

shortcut.detail: Summon Una by the roots. Once the path is open, head through toward the cemetery while she finishes singing.

optional.hint: Defeat the Rotten Druid

name: Cemetery of the Eternals
objective: Recover both keys and confront Lachlann

shortcut.detail: Locate and activate the checkpoints at both tomb entrances before clearing the tombs. Use the cemetery's checkpoint travel to get to the other entrance when you return with a key piece.

name: Mausoleum of the Praetor
objective: Defeat Draven and take his key piece

optional.hint: Open the Forgotten Riches trove

name: Tomb of the Consort
objective: Defeat Asinia and take her key piece

optional.hint: Search the Embattled Trove
Investigate the Hooded One’s request

name: Hunting Grounds
objective: Find the route to Ogham Farmlands

optional.hint: Defeat Crowbell for passive points
Take the side path to Freythorn
Clear the rituals and defeat the King in the Mists for Spirit

name: Ogham Farmlands
objective: Continue to Ogham Village

shortcut.cue: Turn in the lute on your next town trip
shortcut.detail: Pick up Una’s lute on the way to Ogham Village. If you’re stopping in town for Renly’s tools, turn in the lute on the same visit.

optional.hint: Recover Una’s lute for passive points

name: Ogham Village
objective: Defeat the Executioner and rescue Leitis
tip: Fire resistance helps against the Executioner. Move clear when he winds up for a heavy slam.

shortcut.cue: Portal to turn in Renly’s tools
shortcut.detail: If you pick up Renly’s Smithing Tools before the Executioner, portal to town to unlock the Salvage Bench. Make any vendor upgrades on the same trip, then use the portal to return to the village.

optional.hint: Recover Renly’s tools for the Salvage Bench

name: The Manor Ramparts
objective: Find a way into Ogham Manor

name: Ogham Manor
objective: Defeat Count Geonor
tip: Bring cold resistance for Geonor. Beira in Clearfell offers a permanent boost.

optional.hint: Defeat Candlemass for maximum life

name: Vastiri Outskirts
objective: Defeat Rathbreaker to earn passage

shortcut.detail: Once Rathbreaker is down, take a town portal and speak to Zarka to move on to the Ardura Caravan.

name: The Ardura Caravan
objective: Speak with Asala and use the Desert Map

shortcut.cue: For Ancient Vows, leave the Valley last
shortcut.detail: Once the three Horn of the Vastiri branches open, do the Keth and Bone Pits branches before the Valley of the Titans if you’re doing Ancient Vows. Bring both clan relics so you can use the altar on the same visit.

name: Traitor's Passage
objective: Take the passage to the Halani Gates

optional.hint: Defeat Balbala to unlock the Sekhemas trial

name: The Halani Gates
objective: Help Asala open the gates and pursue Jamanra

optional.hint: Defeat L’im the Impaler

name: The Halani Gates
objective: Speak to Asala about the closed gates

name: The Halani Gates
objective: Investigate the sandstorm blocking the pursuit

name: Keth
objective: Find the entrance to the Lost City

optional.hint: Defeat Kabala for passive points

name: The Lost City
objective: Find the Buried Shrines

optional.hint: Look for the Kabala Clan Relic

name: Buried Shrines
objective: Defeat Azarian and recover the water essence
tip: Bring fire resistance for Azarian. The fire offering in the shrine gives you a Ruby Ring.

optional.hint: Look for the Kabala Clan Relic
Claim an elemental resistance ring

name: Mastodon Badlands
objective: Find the entrance to the Bone Pits

name: The Bone Pits
objective: Defeat Iktab and Ekbab for the tusks

optional.hint: Look for the Sun Clan Relic

name: Valley of the Titans
objective: Open the Titan Grotto using the seals

optional.hint: Use both clan relics at the altar

name: The Titan Grotto
objective: Defeat Zalmarath and recover the Flame Ruby

name: Deshar
objective: Find the Path of Mourning

optional.hint: Retrieve the Final Letter for passive points

name: Deshar
objective: Find the Path of Mourning

name: Path of Mourning
objective: Continue toward the Spires of Deshar

name: The Spires of Deshar
objective: Defeat Tor Gul

shortcut.cue: Finish in Deshar before you portal
shortcut.detail: If you want the lightning resistance reward, visit the Sisters of Garukhan before leaving. After Tor Gul, portal to the caravan and speak to Asala to open the Dreadnought route.

optional.hint: Visit the Sisters of Garukhan for lightning resistance

name: Mawdun Quarry
objective: Find the entrance to Mawdun Mine

optional.hint: Recover the Tinker’s Tools

name: Mawdun Mine
objective: Defeat Rudja and free Risu

shortcut.cue: Portal after freeing and speaking to Risu
shortcut.detail: Free Risu after Rudja and speak to her before leaving. Portal to the caravan, then speak to Risu and Asala to continue at the Halani Gates.

optional.hint: Investigate the runic vault

name: The Dreadnought's Wake
objective: Cross the Dreadnought to reach Jamanra

name: Dreadnought
objective: Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination
tip: Bring lightning resistance for Jamanra. Visit the Sisters of Garukhan in the Spires of Deshar for a permanent boost.

name: Trial of the Sekhemas
tip: For a first run, aim for character level 26–30. Equip relics with Honour resistance when available.

optional.hint: Finish the Sekhemas trial for Ascendancy

name: Sandswept Marsh
objective: Cross the marsh to the Ziggurat

optional.hint: Search the Orok camp for supplies

name: Ziggurat Encampment
objective: Work with Alva to open the route below

name: Jungle Ruins
objective: Find the route into the Infested Barrens

optional.hint: Defeat Mighty Silverfist for passive points
Detour into the Venom Crypts
Recover the corpse venom for Servi

name: Infested Barrens
objective: Find the Wetlands and return with a Soul Core

optional.hint: Investigate the Scrying Pool and vault

name: The Matlan Waterways
objective: Drain the canals using the sluice levers

shortcut.cue: Open a portal by the final lever
shortcut.detail: At the final sluice lever, open a town portal beside it. Pull the lever, wait for the quest to update, then take the portal to speak to Alva in the encampment.

optional.hint: Take the detour to the Azak Bog

name: Chimeral Wetlands
objective: Defeat the Chimera and find the Machinarium
tip: The Chimera uses several elements. Balance your elemental resistances before fighting it.

optional.hint: Take its Ultimatum to the Temple of Chaos

name: Jiquani's Machinarium
objective: Use small Soul Cores to reach the Sanctum

optional.hint: Defeat Blackjaw for fire resistance

name: Jiquani's Sanctum
objective: Power the generators and defeat Zicoatl

shortcut.cue: Waypoint back with the Large Soul Core
shortcut.detail: After taking the Large Soul Core from Zicoatl, use the waypoint to return to the Infested Barrens. Take the core to the stone altar to open the Matlan Waterways.

optional.hint: Find the corruption altar
Defeat Ignagduk for Spirit

name: The Drowned City
objective: Cross the ruins to the Apex of Filth

shortcut.detail: Activate the waypoint on your first visit. After getting the Temple Door Idol in Apex of Filth, travel back here and use the nearby entrance to the encampment.

optional.hint: Find the Molten Vault for Oswald

shortcut.cue: Checkpoint back to the vault entrance
shortcut.detail: After taking the Hammer of Kamasa from Mektul, use checkpoint travel to the vault entrance. Return to the Drowned City and continue toward Apex of Filth.

optional.hint: Defeat Mektul and recover the forge treasure

name: The Temple of Chaos
tip: For the campaign Trial of Chaos, aim for character level 42–45 and high fire and lightning resistance.

optional.hint: Bring an Ultimatum to the Trial of Chaos

name: The Trial of Chaos
tip: For the campaign trial, aim for character level 42–45 and high fire and lightning resistance.

optional.hint: Complete the Trial of Chaos for Ascendancy

name: Apex of Filth
objective: Defeat the queen and take the temple idol

shortcut.cue: Return via the Drowned City waypoint
shortcut.detail: After collecting the Temple Door Idol, use the checkpoint to get back to the waypoint. Travel to the Drowned City and leave through its town entrance to reach Alva quickly.

optional.hint: Bring three mushrooms to the Cauldron Keeper

name: Temple of Kopec
bosses: Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun
objective: Defeat Ketzuli and follow Alva through the gateway

name: Utzaal
objective: Defeat Viper Napuatzi and reach Aggorat

optional.hint: Find the Sacrificial Heart
Explore the library for its Vaal lore

name: Aggorat
objective: Find the entrance to the Black Chambers

optional.hint: Offer the Sacrificial Heart for passive points

name: The Black Chambers
objective: Defeat Doryani and advance the story
tip: Prioritize fire and lightning resistance for Doryani. Move away from the back of the machine when its lasers fire.

name: Kingsmarch
objective: Arrange passage with Makoru and investigate the islands

name: Isle of Kin
objective: Find the way into the Volcanic Warrens

optional.hint: Defeat the Blind Beast
Recover a torn map piece

name: Volcanic Warrens
objective: Defeat Krutog and release Matiki

shortcut.cue: Return to the ship after freeing Matiki
shortcut.detail: After defeating Krutog and speaking to Matiki, take the return route to the ship. Ask Makoru to sail to your next island if you have no town turn-ins.

name: Kedge Bay
objective: Continue along the coast to Journey’s End

optional.hint: Recover a torn map piece

name: Journey's End
objective: Defeat Captain Hartlin and recover Verisium

optional.hint: Defeat Omniphobia for passive points

name: Whakapanu Island
objective: Find the Singing Caverns

optional.hint: Defeat the Great White One for its fin
Recover a torn map piece

name: Singing Caverns
objective: Confront Diamora

shortcut.cue: Return to the ship after Diamora
shortcut.detail: After defeating Diamora, talk to the Hooded One and take the return route to the ship. You can save the Humming Pearl turn-in for your next planned town stop.

optional.hint: Recover the pearl from the clam
Pass Hinekora’s trials
Visit the Silent Hall for maximum mana
Defeat Yama to reach the trial
Complete the three tattoo tests
Speak with Navali for passive points

name: Abandoned Prison
objective: Find the way into Solitary Confinement

optional.hint: Choose a flask bonus at the chapel

name: Solitary Confinement
objective: Defeat the Prisoner using the ballistae

shortcut.cue: Return to the ship after the Prisoner
shortcut.detail: After the fight, speak to the Hooded One. Take the return route to the ship and talk to Makoru if you’re ready to sail to another island.

name: Shrike Island
objective: Defeat the Scourge of the Skies

optional.hint: Recover a torn map piece

name: Arastas
objective: Speak to Lorandis and investigate Arastas

name: Arastas
objective: Defeat Torvian and reach the Excavation

optional.hint: Find the two golden bells

name: The Excavation
objective: Defeat Benedictus and follow Tavakai

name: Ngakanu
objective: Find the Heart of the Tribe

optional.hint: Bring the shark fin to Kaimana

name: Ngakanu
objective: Find the Heart of the Tribe

optional.hint: Bring the shark fin to Kaimana

name: Heart of the Tribe
objective: Defeat Tavakai and return to Kingsmarch
tip: Tavakai uses fire, cold, and lightning across his phases. Prepare all three elemental resistances.

optional.hint: Use the completed map to explore with Dannig
Complete the Runeseeker for the Verisium Anvil
